mapper.select: SELECT rp.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , pi.file_path AS thumbnail , COALESCE(rs.averageRating, 0) AS rating , COALESCE(rs.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount , DATE_FORMAT(rp.viewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS viewedAt FROM recent_place rp LEFT JOIN place p ON rp.place_id = p.place_id LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON p.place_id = pi.place_id AND pi.sort_order = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.place_id AS placeId , AVG(pr.rating) AS averageRating , COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM place_review pr GROUP BY pr.place_id ) rs ON rp.place_id = rs.placeId WHERE 1 = 1 AND rp.user_email = #{userEmail} ORDER BY rp.viewed_at DESC LIMIT 10
